name: creatinine-mg-per-litre
note: mg/L is a tenth of mg/dL. Read as mg/dL, a perfectly normal 9.8 mg/L became an eGFR of 6 - dialysis territory for a patient with normal kidneys.

name: creatinine-mg-per-decilitre-unchanged
note: The ordinary unit is unaffected; mg/dL must not match the mg/L rule.

name: reference-limit-before-value
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Test   Ref   Value
HDL    >39   44
note: A one-sided reference limit followed by a plain number is the range column, not the result.

name: threshold-alone-is-the-result
note: A threshold standing alone IS the reported value, and is flagged as a threshold rather than an exact measurement.

name: threshold-followed-by-a-date
note: A trailing date column must not look like the value that follows a reference limit. Getting this wrong returned an eGFR of 8, taken from the 08 of the date.

name: threshold-followed-by-short-date
note: Same with a two-digit year and a status column.

name: mM-is-mmol-per-litre
text:
Age: 58
Sex: F
TC 5.4 mM, HDL 1.2 mM, LDL 3.4 mM
note: mM is a written form of mmol/L. The mM alternative is matched case-sensitively so mmHg can never satisfy it.

name: mmHg-is-not-mM
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
BP 138/84 mmHg
Total chol 198
HDL 44
note: The unit on a blood pressure must not be read as a cholesterol unit.

name: panel-declares-units-in-header
text:
Age: 58
Sex: F
Lipid Profile (all results in mmol/L)
Cholesterol  5.4
HDL  1.3
LDL  3.3
note: A panel may declare its units once in a header instead of on every row.

name: parenthetical-conversion-is-not-a-declaration
text:
Age: 58
Sex: F
Total cholesterol 209 mg/dL (5.4 mmol/L)
HDL 50 mg/dL (1.3 mmol/L)
note: A dual-reported value contains the word mmol but does not declare the panel's units; the primary value and its own unit lead.

name: unitless-small-value-still-blank
note: With no unit printed and no panel declaration, a small magnitude stays ambiguous and is left blank.

name: egfr-with-equation-year
note: The equation's year sits between the label and the value. A year cannot be a value for any field capped well below it.

name: uacr-may-legitimately-be-a-year-like-number
note: UACR runs to 25000, so a four-digit number there is a real result and must not be stripped as a year.

name: a1c-in-ifcc-units
note: IFCC units sit outside the 3-20 percent window and were simply missed. NGSP percent = IFCC/10.929 + 2.15.

name: a1c-dual-units-takes-percent
note: When both are printed the percent is the one the model wants.

name: fullwidth-digits
text:
Age: ５８
Sex: M
BMI: ２７．４
Total chol: 198
note: Fullwidth forms appear in text copied through some viewers. Each maps to exactly one ASCII character, so the source highlighter stays aligned.

name: lone-systolic-beside-another-vital
note: A systolic labelled BP with a different vital beside it rather than a diastolic. The heart rate must not become the diastolic, but the systolic is still readable.

name: lone-systolic-alone
note: Same with nothing after it.

name: lone-systolic-does-not-override-a-pair
note: The fallback is a last resort: a proper dated pair still decides.

name: lone-systolic-does-not-revive-a-goal
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Plan: BP goal under 130
note: The fallback runs on the masked text, so a target stays excluded.
